name: Harbin Institute of Technology
supervisors: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)

evidence.summary: HIT is one of the Seven Sons of National Defence, the seven universities run directly by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, which CSET found supply about three-quarters of the graduates hired by China’s defence-industry state-owned companies. HIT describes its own strengths as aerospace-based engineering in service of national defence.
HIT hosts two national defence science, technology and industry innovation centres, for ultra-precision machining and for welding automation.
HIT reports to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
